rows.note: This is the formal all-purpose noun for a state of listlessness, low energy, or lack of enthusiasm.

example.english: These days, the lethargy from too much work makes me not want to do anything.
example.traditional: 呢排工作太多，我成日有倦怠感，乜都唔想做。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 gung1 zok3 taai3 do1 ngo5 seng4 jat6 jau5 gyun6 toi5 gam2 mat1 dou1 m4 soeng2 zou6

rows.note: Use this specifically when the lethargy is drowsiness or a strong tendency to fall asleep.

example.english: After dinner, my lethargy was so strong that I almost fell asleep on the bus.
example.traditional: 食完飯之後睡意好重，我差啲喺巴士度瞓着。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6 seoi6 ji3 hou2 cung5 ngo5 caa1 di1 hai2 baa1 si2 dou6 fan3 zoek6

rows.note: Use this slice of the sense when the emphasis is extreme physical or mental fatigue rather than sleepiness.

example.english: After staying up several nights in a row, I had lethargy throughout my body and did not even want to move.
example.traditional: 連續捱咗幾晚夜，我全身都係疲勞，郁都唔想郁。
example.jyutping: lin4 zuk6 ngaai4 zo2 gei2 maan5 je6 ngo5 cyun4 san1 dou1 hai6 pei4 lou4 juk1 dou1 m4 soeng2 juk1
